commands.name: add-link
commands.title: Add Link
commands.description: Add a web page to 2Do as a task, titled and described from the page.

commands.name: view-tasks
commands.title: View Tasks
commands.description: Browse 2Do tasks by scope, list, or smart list, and edit, complete, or open them.

commands.name: view-tasks-today
commands.title: View Tasks: Today
commands.description: Browse today's 2Do tasks, optionally narrowed to a list or smart list.

commands.name: view-tasks-now
commands.title: View Tasks: Now
commands.description: Browse today's 2Do tasks that have started: no start time, or a start time that has passed.

commands.name: view-tasks-later-today
commands.title: View Tasks: Later Today
commands.description: Browse today's 2Do tasks whose start time is still ahead.

commands.name: view-tasks-starred
commands.title: View Tasks: Starred
commands.description: Browse starred 2Do tasks, optionally narrowed to a list or smart list.

commands.name: view-tasks-scheduled
commands.title: View Tasks: Scheduled
commands.description: Browse scheduled 2Do tasks, optionally narrowed to a list or smart list.

commands.name: view-tasks-paused
commands.title: View Tasks: Paused
commands.description: Browse 2Do tasks hidden by paused tags, optionally narrowed to a paused tag, list, or smart list.

commands.name: view-tasks-goals
commands.title: View Tasks: Goals
commands.description: Browse 2Do tasks tracked as goals, with their progress, optionally narrowed to a list or smart list.

commands.name: view-tasks-done
commands.title: View Tasks: Done
commands.description: Browse completed 2Do tasks, optionally narrowed to a list or smart list.

preferences.name: cancelBehavior
preferences.title: Cancel Task
preferences.description: What the Cancel Task action does.

preferences.name: cancelTag
preferences.title: Cancel Tag
preferences.description: The 2Do tag that marks a cancelled task. It's created in 2Do the first time it's needed.

preferences.name: cancelList
preferences.title: Cancel List
preferences.description: The 2Do list cancelled tasks move to, for "Move to List and Complete".

preferences.name: goalTag
preferences.title: Goal Tag
preferences.description: The 2Do tag that marks a goal task. It's created in 2Do the first time it's needed.

preferences.name: goalDateFormat
preferences.title: Goal Date Format
preferences.description: How the extension writes dates in a goal's notes. Goals read any common format either way.
